howto: Press Play: the ball waits at the top of the circle until your first tap.
Tap or press Space to spin the ball round the circle; it slows down on its own.
When a ring closes in, be on the segment that matches your ball's colour.
Your colour changes after every ring. A wrong colour costs a heart.
tips: Taps stack: two quick taps spin the ball about twice as far.
Passing through the middle of a segment keeps a Bullseye streak going.
Hearts come back at 10, 25 and 40 rings.
Gold rings are worth 2 extra points.
Chaos mode flickers your colour every second: watch the ball, not the ring.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow to spin. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: rings arrive more often, spin faster and close in quicker as your score climbs. Chaos mode is the hard mode.

cheats.effect: Any colour: every segment lets the ball through
Slow rings: rings close in 40% slower
Nine lives: runs start with 9 hearts

features.one-tap-start: Play, then one tap spins the ball and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again or Space on the results card goes straight back to the ball at the top
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the score at the top of the screen, and on the title
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run explains colours, rings and gold rings
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, Bullseye best, Chaos best and lifetime rings
